name: Ksar of Ait-Ben-Haddou
description: Ait-Ben-Haddou is a fortified village of mud-brick houses in Morocco's Ouarzazate province, stacked up a hillside along the old caravan route between the Sahara and Marrakesh. Its clay buildings huddle inside high defensive walls with corner towers, glowing red-ochre against the pre-Saharan landscape. Walking its narrow lanes shows how southern Moroccan communities once built and defended their homes.
